description: Show a status such as typing or upload_photo in a chat for about five seconds or until the bot's next message. While a task works on an incoming message the interface already shows typing.

chat_id.description: Chat to act in: chat.id from a telegram.event, or a public @username. Omit it only for the configured home chat or the single allowed user.

topic_id.description: Forum topic: topic_id from the telegram.event.

action.description: Status to show; typing by default.
